personality_one_liner: A premium cinematic dark-mode streaming catalog with high-contrast red accents and translucent glass layering.

spacing.rule: Use generous padding for cinematic feel. No extra margins outside of structural constraints.

do's: Use blur on the bottom floating navigation pill.
Use blur on bottom-sheet headers and backgrounds.
Use heavy tint beneath blur (>=75% surface) to maintain text legibility.
dont's: Do not blur movie posters or dense metadata.
Do not use blur on primary red CTA buttons.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Discover trending movies and series via a dense poster grid.

states.empty: Empty cinema seats illustration with 'Нет доступного контента'.
states.error: Error message with a red 'Повторить' (Retry) button.

screens.layout: Sticky top filter chips (Все/Сериалы/Фильмы/Аниме/Мультфильмы) scrolling horizontally. Below: 3-column movie poster grid using Flexbox (width: (screen - 2*padding - 2*gap) / 3, gap: 8px). Posters are rounded 16px, 2/3 aspect ratio, with rating badge top-right and gradient overlay at bottom.

screens.name: Collections
screens.layout: 2-column grid of wide tiles. Tiles have subtle dark gradients (surfaceTertiary to surfaceSecondary) with title overlay.

screens.name: Search

states.empty: Search icon or empty cinema image with 'Ничего не найдено'.

screens.layout: Top search input with clear button. Results displayed in a 3-column movie poster grid identical to Home.

screens.name: Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific movie or series.
screens.layout: Large hero backdrop image (full width, height ~45vh) with a heavy linear gradient scrim (transparent to surface Inverse) at the bottom. Overlay Title, meta (genre/year/country), and ratings row. Description text. Horizontal scroll for cast avatars (real images or fallback initials). Similar titles horizontal scroll. Episodes schedule in vertical list.

screens.name: Player
screens.layout: Fullscreen black background. Custom transparent overlay controls: Play/Pause, timeline slider, fullscreen toggle.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User account management and saved content access.
screens.layout: User account card at top (surfaceSecondary). Vertical list of menu items (Досмотреть, Закладки, Обновления сериалов) with trailing chevrons.

screens.name: Auth
screens.layout: Single column form. Brand logo at top. Email/password inputs. Sticky primary red CTA at bottom (inside KeyboardAvoidingView).

empty_state_cinema.alt: Empty red cinema seats in the dark

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the exact colors requested: Background #0a0a0b, Cards #17171a / #1e1e22, Accent Red #e6402f, Gold #e8b64c.
Movie posters must be rendered with an aspect ratio of 2/3 and 16px border-radius.
Apply a bottom gradient overlay on posters for text/rating readability.
The bottom navigation must be a custom floating absolute layout: wrapper (flexDirection: row) containing a blurred translucent pill (flex: 1) and a SEPARATE circular search FAB next to it.
Implement bottom sheets using @gorhom/bottom-sheet for watch options (voice/season/episode/quality), share, and bookmarks. Use blurred or surfaceSecondary backgrounds.
Ensure Detail screen hero images have a top-to-bottom vertical linear gradient scrim fading to #0a0a0b at the bottom (opacity minimum 80% to ensure contrast with title).
All text is Russian, so use standard Inter or system fonts to mimic Apple's SF Pro closely.
